source.method: GitHub exact-TPL code search against pinned vanilla-derived quest and hideout datasets

decision: Vanilla demand overlaps the selected payload, but not as a duplicate of Admiral's one-off maintenance-reserve operation. WD-40 is consumed by a vanilla find objective and all three selected TPLs are demanded by hideout progression in the pinned dataset. This is acquisition pressure, not a permanent supply faucet and not a reason by itself to replace ordinary field-service consumables. The overlap is therefore accepted while Economy Admiral review remains fail-closed for aggregate burden and reward sizing.
